evidence: The resulting ﬁlms were analyzed by XRD, RBS, XRF, FTIR, XPS and AFM to determine ﬁlm crystallinity, stoichiometry, possible impurities and surface morphology, respectively. Film crystallinity and preferred orientations were studied by X-ray diffraction using Cu K a radiation. To get more information on residual carbon impurities, Sr –O and Sr –Ti–O thin ﬁlms were also analyzed by FTIR spectroscopy. Film surface chemistry was studied with XPS by using monochromated Al K a irradiation. Surface morphology of selected strontium titanate ﬁlm samples was studied by Nanoscope III atomic force microscope. Roughness values were calculated as root mean square (rms) values. The Sr to Ti ratio of the ﬁlms was determined semiquantitatively using Philips PW 1480 X-ray ﬂuorescence spectrometer.
